title: Pasta with Zucchini plant and flowers

media.caption: Remove the softest stalks from the main trunk of the plant.
Continue trimming and cleaning the zucchini stalks, removing the tougher outer fibers.
Cut the cleaned stalks and tender leaves into smaller, manageable pieces.
Wash the prepared zucchini plants and flowers thoroughly under running water.
The cleaned and prepped zucchini plants and flowers, ready to be cooked with the pasta.

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Antioxidants
healthBenefits.text: Zucchini flowers and tender shoots contain vitamin C and carotenoids that help combat oxidative stress.

healthBenefits.title: Sustained Energy
healthBenefits.text: Penne pasta provides complex carbohydrates for steady, long-lasting energy release.

healthBenefits.title: Immune Support
healthBenefits.text: Garlic contains allicin, a compound with antimicrobial and immune-boosting properties.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil is high in monounsaturated fats that support cardiovascular health.

healthBenefits.title: Low Calorie, High Fibre
healthBenefits.text: Zucchini plant greens add fibre and volume to the dish while keeping calories low.

healthBenefits.title: Hydrating
healthBenefits.text: Zucchini plants have high water content, contributing to hydration and digestive health.

_ingredientsText:
400 gr of zucchini plants and flowers, cleaned 
300 gr of penne pasta
1 clove garlic, chopped 
salt
2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
